summary: Clarify capability-first Luna evaluation via Codex headless, removing an initial productivity gate and arbitrary per-task repair limits. Record a cumulative check-in before call 201. Preserve the full release target and earlier Stratic/documentation changes. No model calls or Lean changes.

Reviewed its summary and scope note, and reconciled affected passage selectors. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Reviewed its summary and scope note, and reconciled affected passage selectors. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Explained allocation, launch, dependencies, lifetime, buffers and runtime; preserved visibility, ownership and concrete-runtime obligations. Reviewed its summary and scope note, and reconciled affected passage selectors. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Added an explicit entry into Memory observations and ordering alongside Execution environment, preserving the original semantics responsibility. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Clarified PTX, GPU, registers, tensors and the roles of Lean and TorchLean; retained the full intended scope and all distinctions between kinds of correctness. Reviewed its summary and scope note, and reconciled affected passage selectors. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Defined operands, predicates, words, traces, dependencies, state, dispatch and fuel; preserved the instruction subset, stopping conditions and text-interface boundary. Reviewed its summary and scope note, and reconciled affected passage selectors. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Explained elementwise computation, aliasing, weak memory and the bounded sum; retained initial states, numeric bounds, step budget and concurrent-model limits. Reviewed its summary and scope note, and reconciled affected passage selectors. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Explained assertions, preconditions, framing, invariants and termination measures; retained all four contracts and their quantification. Reviewed its summary and scope note, and reconciled affected passage selectors. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Clarified the division of work: reviewed shared foundations and coordination, smaller-model instruction workers, and independent evaluation. Existing source and proof evidence is preserved; the summary and unimplemented workflow status were reviewed.

Explained lanes, interleavings, invariants, scope and memory events; retained layout, bounds, schedule quantifiers and the execution-to-graph connection. Reviewed its summary and scope note, and reconciled affected passage selectors. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Extracted allocation checks and scalar-execution connections, preserving alignment, ownership, known-content and lifetime qualifications. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Extracted thread identity, grouping, scope membership and mutual inclusion, preserving exclusions for host execution and physical launch mappings. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Introduced tensors, layouts, mixed precision, contracts, fusion and orchestration; retained numerical and memory obligations and separate PTX backward proofs. Reviewed its summary and scope note, and reconciled affected passage selectors. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Extracted whole-word observations into a sibling of byte-level observations; explained source identity, ordering checks, program admission and conditional equivalence, with direct existing proof links. Summary and scope note reviewed; evidence and dependency passages checked.

Separate adaptive capability exploration from later frozen productivity evaluation. Keep strict artifact correctness while making run limits and check-in points explicit policies rather than invented acceptance conditions. Summary remains accurate; responsibility is still unimplemented.

results.method: Manual policy and contract review; preservation and local-link assertions; stratic validate; git diff --check; exact snapshot comparison.
results.environment: Documentation-only PTXLean proposal, existing Stratic CLI and system Python 3. No headless inference calls; no Lean compilation required for this edit.
results.evidence: Reviewed the distinction between accepted-artifact correctness and exploratory productivity, selected Codex headless route, no arbitrary per-task caps, and cumulative checkpoint before call 201 including retries/resumes/reviewers. Confirmed all other description bodies and all metadata remain unchanged from the prior prepared proposal, local draft links resolve, Stratic is valid and whitespace checks pass. Exact before/after snapshots match. No inference or Lean implementation changes.
